title: Pre-render nutrient cluster surfaces
details: Pre-render nutrient cluster surfaces; cache and only recreate when amount changes >10%. field.py. Убрать пересоздание surface каждый кадр — кэшировать и пересоздавать только при изменении amount >10%.
notes: Pre-rendered and cached nutrient cluster surfaces in field.py draw(). Changes: (1) field.py:46 added self._cluster_cache = {} in __init__; (2) field.py draw() replaced per-frame PixelArray + Python pixel loop with cached numpy buf assignment. Cache keyed by id(cluster), stores (rgbs, amount, gy_a, gx_a). Recomputes only when amount changes >10%. Stale cache entries cleaned at start of draw(). Eliminates: np.where on hot path every frame, PixelArray surface lock/unlock per cluster, Python per-pixel loop. Tested: syntax, cache create/reuse/rebuild/cleanup all pass, 8s sim no errors. cell.py imports CELL_SIZE but unused (dead import, deferred to cleanup).
